Privacy policy

Effective from: 11 November 2026. Česky

Operator

Jaroslav Patočka, contact: admin@insertcreator.com. You can use this contact for questions and to exercise your rights.

Photos and designs

  • Photos are normally processed right in your browser. The exception is the optional background-removal mode, which sends image data to a service at the same origin as the app (see below).
  • The app only receives the photo you choose. It cannot see your gallery or camera and does not read the location from the photo.
  • The photo file is not saved in projects or the tool library; outlines and design settings are saved instead. The image may remain in browser memory while capture, editing or recovery after a cancelled calculation is open.
  • Designs and your library stay in your browser's storage. Clearing the site data deletes them. We do not back them up.

Visitor measurement

On desktop and in the mobile version, but only with your consent, we use Google Analytics from Google Ireland Limited to see how many people use the app. The legal basis is your consent. Without it, Google Analytics does not start. Advertising features are switched off. Data may be transferred to the USA as part of Google's services.

You can withdraw consent at any time with the Cookie settings link in the app footer. Your choice is stored in your browser and we ask again after a year. The desktop and mobile versions store your choice separately.

Hosting

The site runs on Webglobe hosting. As with any website, the server may record technical data during a visit, such as IP address and request time, for operation and security.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your personal data, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object. You can lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (uoou.gov.cz).

Optional background removal by a same-origin service

When “Remove background and shadows first” is selected, the app sends decoded RGBA pixels from the chosen photo, its width, height and a job ID to /api/background/remove at the same origin as the app. This route does not send the original file, its metadata/EXIF or the project. The server also receives ordinary network-request information. The photo dialog identifies this mode before file selection; it may be preselected when the local service is used.

The same origin means the same protocol, host and port. It does not prove that the server runs on your device. With the supplied local service, computation takes place on the computer where the service was started. A phone connected to that service sends pixels over the network to that computer. The supplied local server uses HTTP without login; the transfer from the phone is therefore not encrypted. Use it only on a trusted network you control.

The supplied local service code uses image data in memory during computation in a disposable process; it does not create photo files or write their contents to application logs. This is not a guarantee of immediate secure memory erasure and does not describe possible operating-system logs, swap files or the configuration of another server.

The static app files alone do not provide this service. This mode cannot work without an available service; selecting it can nevertheless cause the app to attempt to send image data to the same origin even if the server later rejects the request. For processing without this transfer, use ordinary browser selection and editing. An already transparent PNG can also be processed without the service. This description does not confirm that such an API is available on the public website.
